Title: Employee Handbook
Content: Employees are entitled to 20 annual leave days and must obtain manager approval before extended leave.

Title: IT Security Policy
Content: Passwords must be changed every 90 days. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory.

Title: Travel Policy
Content: Domestic travel requires manager approval. International travel requires director approval.

Title: Expense Policy
Content: Meals up to $50 per day are reimbursable with receipts.
